create_InGraphBatchEnv: create an InGraphBatchEnv instance wrapping a batch environment for TensorFlow graph integration
simulate_InGraphBatchEnv: simulate a batch of environments by stepping them with action tensors inside the TF graph
reset_InGraphBatchEnv: reset all or selected environments in the batch and return new observation tensors
access_InGraphBatchEnv_properties: access the observ, action, reward, and done properties to read current batch state variables
close_InGraphBatchEnv: close the InGraphBatchEnv and send close messages to the underlying batch environment processes
